agent_data_note: Use the real replication package at `dataset_candidate/llm-agents-study/`. It is mounted read-only; copy it to `project/llm-agents-study/` before running author scripts that write outputs.
benchmark_rules: Use only the provided annotated trajectories and derived data under `dataset_candidate/llm-agents-study/`; do not fabricate trajectories or annotations.
Read `dataset_candidate/dataset_paths.json` before analysis and use `$LLM_AGENTS_STUDY_HOME` in Python scripts.
The shared dataset is read-only. Copy it to `project/llm-agents-study/` before running scripts that generate figures, sequence files, or other outputs.
The Python analysis environment is installed automatically and available through `python` or `/opt/ase-2025-008-venv/bin/python`.
Separate successful and unsuccessful trajectories and report agent-specific sample sizes.
Existing relationship labels may be reused for analysis; do not claim newly performed human annotation unless annotators actually supplied it.
non_goals: Re-running AutoCodeRover, OpenHands, or RepairAgent to regenerate trajectories
Using synthetic trajectories as the main experiment data
Modifying the read-only shared replication package
Claiming independent human annotation from automated relabeling
